updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Unified Classification Management Experience
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview is consolidating all classifier types—Sensitive Information Types, Exact Data Match, fingerprint SITs, and trainable classifiers—into a single unified interface for discovery, creation, validation, and management. This streamlines compliance workflows by eliminating the need to navigate multiple tools and reduces administrative overhead.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP – Protection for Excluded Windows Folders
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP is expanding protection coverage to include commonly excluded Windows folders such as Temp and AppData, closing a gap where sensitive data could previously hide. This enhancement increases detection capabilities and reduces the risk of unmonitored data exposure in system directories.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Communication Compliance – Enhanced Policy Conditions
updates.summary: Communication Compliance policies now support external email detection, OR condition logic for custom rule combinations, and pre-implementation testing capabilities. These improvements give compliance officers more granular control over message monitoring and reduce deployment risk through condition validation before go-live.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection Scanner Data Export for Custom Reporting
updates.summary: The information protection scanner now exports labeling, classification, and protection action data to SQL tables, enabling compliance teams to build custom reports on repository state and protection effectiveness. This provides deeper visibility into data governance activities across scanned locations.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Hard Delete for OneDrive and SharePoint
updates.summary: Data Lifecycle Management will introduce hard delete capabilities through secure priority cleanup workflows for OneDrive and SharePoint content, providing admins with more aggressive content disposal options beyond standard retention label and policy deletion. This addresses compliance scenarios requiring permanent data removal within controlled timeframes.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Legacy Teams Retention Policies Scoped to Teams Only
updates.summary: Existing retention policies targeting Microsoft Teams will be converted to Teams-only policies and will no longer implicitly govern Copilot interactions. Admins should review and adjust retention policies if they intended to cover Copilot data to avoid unintended compliance gaps.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP – FTP and SFTP Transfer Monitoring
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP now generally supports monitoring sensitive data transfers over FTP and SFTP protocols with configurable restrictive actions. This closes a critical gap for organizations that rely on legacy file transfer methods and need to prevent data exfiltration across all transfer channels.

updates.title: Multiple Authorization Vulnerabilities in Chromium (Microsoft Edge)
updates.summary: Microsoft Edge addressed nine Chromium-based authorization and access control vulnerabilities across video, remote control, tag handling, downloads, USB, site isolation, extensions, and browser core components. Admins should deploy the latest Edge updates to protect against potential privilege escalation and unauthorized feature access.
